newsitem.title: USA: Heinz names O'Neill StarKist chief - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Heinz names O'Neill StarKist chief - WSJ.

text.p: H.J. Heinz Co named Daniel O'Neill executive vice president in charge of it StarKist tuna, pet food and Latin American operations, but Campbell Soup Co, where O'Neill has headed the U.S. soup business, vowed to fight the move, The Wall Street Journal reported Tuesday.
Heinz said it hired O'Neill away from Campbell to become one of four Heinz executive vice presidents, the story said.
But the Journal quotes Campbell spokesman Kevin Lowery as saying the company intends to enforce an 18-month non-compete agreement that O'Neill signed in 1995.
